# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A comprehensive database documenting internet culture, viral memes, TikTok trends, and scientific content, tracking the origins and evolution of online phenomena.

This site aggregates content from Know Your Meme, the leading internet meme encyclopedia, and Scientific American, covering everything from TikTok viral trends and catchphrases to exploitable image macros and social media phenomena. The database provides detailed explanations of meme origins, cultural context, and spread across platforms like TikTok, Twitter/X, Reddit, and YouTube.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Catchphrases and internet slang
- Viral meme explanations
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- YouTube and DeviantArt content
- Dance memes and audio trends
- Breaking Bad and TV show memes
- Hood culture and nostalgia memes
- Looksmaxxing and internet subcultures
- Mental health memes
- Millennial culture commentary
- Conspiracy theories and viral debunks

## Viral Meme Entries

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman confusion
- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme entry featuring art of girl with cat, viral on TikTok
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's song 'Innit' from Atlanta
- [Millennial Burger Place](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking cliche millennial burger restaurant starter pack
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok as viral audio

## Meme Explainer Guides

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Guide explaining Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok/Instagram
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide on Nasra Ahmed viral ICE incident memes from Minneapolis speech
- [What Does 'Clavicular Brutally Frame Mogged By ASU Frat Leader' Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-does-clavicular-brutally-frame-mogged-by-asu-frat-leader-mean-the-memes-about-the-viral-looksmaxxer-explained): Guide explaining looksmaxxing 'frame mogged' meme with Clavicular at ASU
- [Are 'Labubus' Demonic?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/are-labubus-demonic-the-viral-conspiracy-theory-linking-labubu-dolls-to-the-demon-pazuzu-explained): Guide debunking Labubu doll conspiracy linking Kasing Lung toys to Pazuzu

## Meme Collections

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of 22 relatable mental health memes about depression and anxiety
